[Humor] 90s Game reviewer mixes up a real and a bootleg game.

You are mistaken OP. This was a Russian TV show that promoted games for the Dendy. The Dendy was the Eastern European Famiclone (bootleg NES) that was wildly popular in the region throughout the 90's because at the time most people couldn't afford the new consoles and the exorbitant prices of legit carts/discs. All the Dendy games were bootlegs and many of them came on multicarts.

I used to have one myself back in Ukraine before I immigrated to the US. Was going to bring mine with me, but the fucking thing was PAL. I played most of the big classics on mine. From Contra to Darkwing Duck and everything in between. A buddy of mine even had a bootleg Duck Hunt with the gun and everything.
